faq.q: How do I join an event?
faq.a: Tap Join on the event details. Once the organizer approves you, you can enter the chat.

faq.q: Why can I leave an event?
faq.a: You can leave a published event with Leave. You can't leave events that have ended or been cancelled.
In-app notifications work. Push notifications on device are still disabled on the server side.

feedback.title: Have a suggestion?
feedback.description: If something is confusing or you'd like a new feature, write to us.
